name: Document Acquisition
description: Capture documents encountered during browsing, launch indexed document searches, and analyze acquired files for URLs, compression, and interesting keywords.

commands.title: Start Document Session
commands.description: Create a fresh document acquisition session and output folder.

commands.title: Launch Indexed Searches
commands.description: Open target-aware Google queries for indexed documents.

commands.title: Scan Current Page Links
commands.description: Discover and queue document links visible on the current page.

commands.title: Open Session Folder
commands.description: Reveal the most recent downloaded document for the active session.

commands.title: Download Reviewed Document
commands.description: Download one reviewed queue item after the tester approves it.

commands.title: Clear Document Inventory
commands.description: Clear BLANCHE document metadata and start a clean session.

settingsSchema.title: Auto-Capture Browsed Documents
settingsSchema.description: Automatically fetch document bodies into memory for bounded analysis and queue them for review.

settingsSchema.title: Enable Rule-Based Review Queue
settingsSchema.description: Mark matching high-scoring documents for explicit tester download approval. Filesystem downloads never occur automatically.

settingsSchema.title: Review Queue Score
settingsSchema.description: When rule-based review queuing is enabled, require at least this interest score.

settingsSchema.title: Download Rule Keywords
settingsSchema.description: Only automatically download reviewed documents matching one of these keywords.
settingsSchema.defaultValue: credential, secret, token, api_key, client_secret, private key, confidential, restricted

settingsSchema.title: Maximum Document Bytes
settingsSchema.description: Skip automatic acquisition when a known Content-Length exceeds this size.

settingsSchema.title: Download Folder Root
settingsSchema.description: Downloads are saved under this folder, with a child folder per BLANCHE document session.

settingsSchema.title: Interesting Keywords
settingsSchema.description: Comma, semicolon, or newline separated keywords counted during document review.
settingsSchema.defaultValue: password, passwd, credential, secret, token, api_key, apikey, bearer, authorization, client_secret, private key, aws_access_key_id, connection string, jdbc, ldap, saml, oauth, sso, vpn, admin, internal, confidential, restricted, staging, dev, prod, database, payroll, ssn

collectors.name: Document Response Observer
collectors.description: Observes document-like responses from active browsing and queues acquisition.

collectors.name: Document Link Scanner
collectors.description: Discovers document URLs from the current page DOM.

uiContributions.title: Documents
uiContributions.description: Acquire and review documents encountered during browsing.

uiContributions.title: Documents
uiContributions.description: Acquire and review documents associated with the inspected tab.
